message.content: {"rules":["Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that the iterator's size_hint is exact.","Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must ensure that the iterator's size_hint is cheap to call.","Implementors of TrustedRandomAccess must not override TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size.","All subtypes and all supertypes of a type implementing TrustedRandomAccess must also implement TrustedRandomAccess.","If Self implements ExactSizeIterator, self.len() must always produce results consistent with self.size().","If Self implements Iterator, calling <Self as Iterator>::__iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) must be safe provided all of the following hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self does not implement Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after this call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with that limit calculated individually for self and each clone but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after this call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Coercing self to a supertype T, including through multiple coercion steps, is permitted; after this call, the same method restriction applies to resulting coerced values, and calls to __iterator_get_unchecked with the same index and calls to next_back are added across self and its successive coercion results when enforcing the stated limits.","If Self implements Iterator, __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx) must not change the value returned by size_hint, provided all of the following hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self does not implement Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after this call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with that limit calculated individually for self and each clone but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after this call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Coercing self to a supertype T, including through multiple coercion steps, is permitted; after this call, the same method restriction applies to resulting coerced values, and calls to __iterator_get_unchecked with the same index and calls to next_back are added across self and its successive coercion results when enforcing the stated limits.","If Self implements Iterator, after calling __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx), it must remain safe to call Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size on self, assuming the required traits are implemented and provided all of the following hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self does not implement Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after this call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with that limit calculated individually for self and each clone but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after this call, only those six methods are called on self or any new clones. Coercing self to a supertype T, including through multiple coercion steps, is permitted; after this call, the same method restriction applies to resulting coerced values, and calls to __iterator_get_unchecked with the same index and calls to next_back are added across self and its successive coercion results when enforcing the stated limits.","If Self implements Iterator, it must be safe to drop self after calling __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx), provided all of the following hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self does not implement Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after this call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with that limit calculated individually for self and each clone but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after this call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Coercing self to a supertype T, including through multiple coercion steps, is permitted; after this call, the same method restriction applies to resulting coerced values, and calls to __iterator_get_unchecked with the same index and calls to next_back are added across self and its successive coercion results when enforcing the stated limits.","If Self implements Iterator and is a subtype of T, it must be safe to coerce self to T after calling __iterator_get_unchecked(&mut self, idx), provided all of the following hold: 0 <= idx < self.size(); if Self does not implement Clone, the same index is never used more than once on self; after this call, next_back() is called at most self.size() - idx - 1 times, with that limit calculated individually for self and each clone but with next_back() calls before cloning counting for both; after this call, only Clone::clone, Iterator::size_hint, DoubleEndedIterator::next_back, ExactSizeIterator::len, Iterator::__iterator_get_unchecked, and TrustedRandomAccessNoCoerce::size are called on self or any new clones. Multiple coercion steps to supertypes are permitted; after this call, the same method restriction applies to resulting coerced values, and calls to __iterator_get_unchecked with the same index and calls to next_back are added across self and its successive coercion results when enforcing the stated limits."]}
